# Presetter

> Presetter is a macOS utility for Ableton Live 12 that puts every preset from every third-party plugin you own inside Live's browser — filtered with Live's own tags, previewed without loading anything, and loaded into the original plugin when you drag one in.

## What it does

- Reads the presets already installed on your Mac for every supported instrument and effect, and the categories each manufacturer gave them.
- Converts each preset into a format Ableton Live loads directly, maps the manufacturer's categories and descriptors onto Live 12's Sounds and Character tags, and renders a short audio preview from your own copy of the plugin.
- Builds one Ableton Pack that appears under Packs in Live's browser, beside Ableton's own content. Presets are filterable by sound, character, and vendor, previewable without loading a plugin, and load into the original plugin with macros mapped.
- Runs once; run it again when you install a new plugin. Nothing runs inside Live. Nothing is uploaded or redistributed.

## Supported plugins

- Xfer Records: Serum, Serum 2
- Spectrasonics: Omnisphere, Keyscape
- Native Instruments: Kontakt, Massive, Massive X, FM8, Battery 4, Guitar Rig; effects Driver, Replika XT, Raum, Phasis, Flair, Freak, Choral, Bite, Dirt
- Arturia: Pigments, V Collection
- Valhalla DSP: ValhallaVintageVerb, ValhallaSupermassive, ValhallaSpaceModulator
- Every NKS-ready plugin (Native Instruments' preset standard; 250+ developers, 2,000+ instruments and effects), including u-he Diva, Zebra, Hive, UVI Falcon, Rob Papen, Heavyocity, Output.

## Requirements

- macOS 11 Big Sur or later, Intel Core i5 or Apple silicon, 8 GB RAM (the same requirements as Ableton Live 12)
- Ableton Live 12.0 or later
- The plugins themselves, installed and licensed on the same Mac
- Windows is planned, not available at launch

## Pricing

- One-time purchase, $149. Launch price $79 for the early-access list. No subscription. All sales final.
